text: The swings at the playground near Adams Street in Dorchester have been broken for about three weeks. Two of the four seats are wrapped in caution tape and there's always a line of kids waiting.
There's no shade at all over the play structure at our park in Mattapan. By 1pm in July the slide is too hot to touch, so we only go early in the morning.
The splash pad at the playground in Jamaica Plain was off most of August. It's the only water play within walking distance for a lot of families on our street.
Please add lights along the walking path through the park by Bennington Street in East Boston. It's pitch black after 6pm in the fall and I walk home from the train that way.
The basketball court lights in Roxbury shut off at 8pm. Teenagers who work after school can't play, and they end up hanging around the corner store instead.
The bathrooms at the baseball field in Hyde Park are locked every weekend during Little League. Parents and kids have to leave to use the gas station.
Love the new playground in Charlestown! The rubber surface is so much better than the wood chips and my daughter's wheelchair can actually roll right up to the merry-go-round.
Trash cans at the park on Dorchester Avenue overflow every Sunday night after weekend cookouts. By Monday there's garbage blowing all over the grass and the playground.
Someone spray painted the whole back wall of the field house in Brighton about a month ago and it's still there. I reported it to 311 twice.
We need a fenced dog park in the South End. Right now everyone lets their dogs off leash on the playground lawn and it scares the little kids.
The climbing structure at the playground in Roslindale has a cracked platform with a sharp edge. My son cut his hand on it last Saturday. It should be fixed before someone gets hurt worse.
The soccer field in East Boston floods every time it rains and stays muddy for days. Our youth league had to cancel four games this season.
There are no benches near the toddler area at our playground in Mission Hill. Grandparents who watch the kids have to stand the whole time or sit on the ground.
It would be great to have free outdoor fitness classes in the park on weekend mornings. A lot of us in Dorchester can't afford a gym.
El parque cerca de mi casa en East Boston no tiene letreros en español. No sabía que la piscina cerraba temprano los domingos hasta que llegué con mis hijos.
Los columpios para bebés del parque en Jamaica Plain están rotos desde junio. Mi hija tiene un año y no hay otro lugar seguro para que juegue.
The path around Jamaica Pond is great but there are only two water fountains and one of them hasn't worked all summer. Runners and dog walkers really need more.
Huge thanks to the crew who replanted the trees along the edge of the park in Roslindale this spring. It already feels cooler and the kids love the new flower beds.

I tried to reserve the picnic area in Franklin Park for my son's birthday and couldn't figure out the permit website. I called and nobody called me back. We ended up just showing up and another group was already there.
The tennis courts in West Roxbury have huge cracks and weeds growing through the surface. One of the nets has been missing since spring.
Could the city add pickleball lines to one of the tennis courts in Allston? There are dozens of us who play and we're setting up portable nets in a parking lot.
The entrance ramp to the playground in Hyde Park is too steep for my power chair and there's a curb at the bottom with no cut. I can watch my grandkids from the sidewalk but I can't get in.
Broken glass under the swings again at the park near Blue Hill Avenue. This happens every weekend. Can someone sweep it on Monday mornings?
The community garden in the South End has had no water hookup since May. We're carrying jugs from home to keep the plots alive.
Park in Chinatown is very small and always crowded with seniors doing tai chi in the morning and kids after school. Please add more seating and some shade structures.
The grass at the park on Centre Street in West Roxbury hasn't been mowed in what looks like a month. It's knee high in places and full of ticks.
I feel unsafe walking through the park in Mattapan at night. Half the lights are out and there are a lot of hidden spots behind the overgrown bushes near the entrance.
The new turf field in South Boston is beautiful, but it's booked by permitted leagues almost every evening. There's no time left for kids in the neighborhood to just show up and play.
No restrooms anywhere near the playground in the North End. Parents with potty-training toddlers have to leave after 20 minutes.
We found out the playground in Brighton was getting torn down for a renovation from a sign that went up the day before. Nobody asked the neighborhood what we wanted in the new design.
The spray deck in Roxbury is fantastic this year, running every day and super clean. My kids beg to go after camp. Thank you!
The fence around the toddler playground in Dorchester has a gap near the gate big enough for a two-year-old to slip through, right next to a busy street.
Movie nights in the park last summer in Jamaica Plain were the best thing that happened in our neighborhood. Please bring them back and add a few in other neighborhoods too.
Dog waste everywhere on the lawn at the park in Fenway. The bag dispensers have been empty for weeks.
The only pool near us in Mattapan opened two weeks late and closed the week before Labor Day. During the heat wave families had nowhere to cool down.
The trail in the woods behind our park in Hyde Park is covered with fallen trees from the last storm. You have to climb over three of them to get through.
There's no accessible swing at any playground in Charlestown that I know of. My nephew uses a wheelchair and just sits and watches when we visit.
Basketball hoops at the court in South Boston have no nets and one rim is bent down. Kids still play but it's sad to see.
It would help if park closures and repairs were posted somewhere online in more than English. Lots of parents at our playground in East Boston speak Spanish or Portuguese.
The benches along the harbor walk park in the North End are falling apart, with rotted boards and exposed screws. Seniors use them every day.
